experiment.topic: Statistical Validation of Opening Range Breakouts in Crypto Assets (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD) 2019-
experiment.hypothesis: A 30-hour opening range breakout with a 3% price threshold on BTC-USD, ETH-USD, and SOL-USD generates statistically significant positive returns in a regime shift, with a false breakout rate below 20%.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If, over a 12-month period, the 30-hour opening range breakout rule fails to generate at least 30% positive returns on average across BTC-USD, ETH-USD, and SOL-USD with a false signal rate exceeding 20%, the hypothesis is falsified.
